name: Button
implementation_rule: Use one primary task action per section. Use LinkButton for navigation; label icon-only actions and disable duplicate submissions.

name: Calendar
implementation_rule: Use for explicit date selection. Preserve keyboard movement and distinguish today from the selected day.

name: Checkbox
implementation_rule: Use for independent or multiple choices; associate a visible label and keep selection controlled.

name: Comment
implementation_rule: Use only for genuine user discussion with author and timestamp; do not repurpose for delivery events.

name: Date time picker
implementation_rule: Specify the user timezone, validate future scheduling against API limits, and preserve keyboard entry.

name: Dropdown menu
implementation_rule: Use for secondary actions. Keep menu items actionable, label the trigger, and restore focus after dismissal.

name: Focus ring
implementation_rule: Use supported focusable primitives for new work; preserve visible focus and review the caution notice.

name: Form
implementation_rule: Associate labels, validation and helper text with inputs. Keep field errors inline and retain entered values after errors.

name: Radio
implementation_rule: Use for one choice from a visible small set; give the group a label and meaningful option descriptions.

name: Range
implementation_rule: Use only for approximate values with visible bounds; provide another input when exact values matter.

name: Select
implementation_rule: Use controlled values and stable option identities. Label the field; handle empty and disabled choices.

name: Text area
implementation_rule: Use for multiline prose or source input; provide an appropriate row count and describe formatting requirements.

name: Text field
implementation_rule: Use visible labels, meaningful autocomplete and correct input types. Placeholders supplement labels.

name: Toggle
implementation_rule: Use for immediate reversible settings, with a visible label and failure feedback; otherwise use checkbox plus Save.

name: Avatar
implementation_rule: Provide the entity name and a fallback. Do not use an avatar alone to communicate permissions.

name: Avatar group
implementation_rule: Show relevant people with names available to assistive technology; summarize overflow.

name: Icon
implementation_rule: Use installed ADS core icons. Hide decorative icons and label icon-only actions.

name: Image
implementation_rule: Provide useful alternative text or an empty alternative for decoration; verify light/dark presentation.

name: Object
implementation_rule: Reserve Atlassian-specific object assets for their actual meaning; use mail-domain terminology in this product.

name: Logo
implementation_rule: Retain mymorphix identity. Do not use an Atlassian logo to imply product ownership or certification.

name: Tile
implementation_rule: Use for a recognizable entity or destination, with a visible label and keyboard-accessible action.

name: Badge
implementation_rule: Use for numeric counts. Expose the associated object and do not imply unread data without a backend count.

name: Date label
implementation_rule: Show dates and context accurately; never render a non-interactive date label as an action.

name: Lozenge
implementation_rule: Use short, textual status labels mapped to actual API states. Color is supplementary; acceptance is not inbox placement.

name: Tag
implementation_rule: Use for object metadata or filtering, keeping any removal action keyboard accessible.

name: Tag group
implementation_rule: Keep related tags together and provide a way to inspect overflow rather than silently hiding values.

name: Page
implementation_rule: Do not add the caution-marked layout package. Use the existing semantic Page wrapper and responsive CSS grid.

name: Page header
implementation_rule: Use the shared Page wrapper with one h1, description and wrapping task actions; titles must handle long content.

name: Panel
implementation_rule: Use for contextual adjacent content with a responsive fallback. Review beta API support before adopting.

name: Progress bar
implementation_rule: Show determinate progress only when total work is known; otherwise use an indeterminate loading indicator.

name: Skeleton
implementation_rule: Do not add an early-access dependency just for decoration. Prefer the existing loading state until an API is selected.

name: Spinner
implementation_rule: Announce the loading task in a polite status region, and replace it with error or content when complete.

name: Banner
implementation_rule: Reserve for workspace-wide actionable conditions. Avoid large repeated informational blocks on every page.

name: Empty state
implementation_rule: Distinguish first use, no matching results and permission restrictions. Offer a relevant next action.

name: Flag
implementation_rule: Use success flags for completed mutations. Persist important failures in the affected view instead of relying only on auto-dismiss.

name: Inline message
implementation_rule: Place secondary guidance near the relevant control; do not conceal required instructions in a popup.

name: Modal dialog
implementation_rule: Provide a labelled title, focus containment, Escape behavior and focus return. Initial focus for destructive confirmation is Cancel.

name: Spotlight
implementation_rule: Use current guidance for a specific onboarding task; never block the core task with a marketing tour.

name: Section message
implementation_rule: Show local warnings and errors alongside recovery actions; do not use as the default container for ordinary content.

name: Breadcrumbs
implementation_rule: Use real parent destinations; the current item is text rather than a fake hash link.

name: Link
implementation_rule: Use React Router for internal destinations. Describe external destinations and retain native link keyboard behavior.

name: Menu
implementation_rule: Use structured groups for related actions and preserve keyboard navigation, selection and disabled state.

name: Navigation system
implementation_rule: Preferred migration target for a future shell package change. The current shell is custom semantic navigation, not this package.

name: Pagination
implementation_rule: Use existing server cursors. Never manufacture page totals or page numbers from a single result set.

name: Tabs
implementation_rule: Use for real related views with working data paths; never present unsupported receiving features as functional.

name: Blanket
implementation_rule: Use only behind an active modal layer; underlying content must not remain keyboard-operable.

name: Drawer
implementation_rule: Use a labelled mobile dialog with background inertness, focus trap, Escape close and focus restoration.

name: Inline dialog
implementation_rule: Avoid new use while marked caution; prefer a supported Popup or a plain adjacent explanation.

name: Popup
implementation_rule: Use for brief anchored interactive content, with dismiss behavior and focus return; do not nest modal workflows.

name: Tooltip
implementation_rule: Supplement a visible or accessible label. Never place essential instructions or actionable controls only in a tooltip.

name: Overview
implementation_rule: Prefer supported compiled primitives for new work and verify entry points against the pinned installed package.

name: Box
implementation_rule: Use for token-backed containers; retain meaningful semantic elements when they convey structure.

name: Inline
implementation_rule: Use for horizontal related controls, with wrapping on constrained screens.

name: Stack
implementation_rule: Use for vertical flow with spacing tokens instead of child margin overrides.

name: Flex
implementation_rule: Use for one-dimensional responsive layouts; keep DOM and reading order aligned.

name: Grid
implementation_rule: Use for two-dimensional responsive content; minmax(0, 1fr) prevents long text from forcing page overflow.

name: Bleed
implementation_rule: Use only for intentional container edge alignment; do not hide overflow bugs with negative offsets.

name: XCSS
implementation_rule: Existing usage may remain; avoid expanding a caution-marked styling API when a supported alternative is available.

name: Responsive
implementation_rule: Test the actual workspace at narrow widths and zoom; hiding the sidebar alone is not responsive behavior.

name: Text
implementation_rule: Use body text roles and rem-based ADS typography; use secondary small text sparingly.

name: MetricText
implementation_rule: Use MetricText for dashboard numbers; metrics are not headings.

name: Pressable
implementation_rule: Use only when a standard Button cannot represent the task; retain native button semantics and focus behavior.

name: Anchor
implementation_rule: Use for custom token-styled links when the standard link cannot fit, with valid href and accessible text.

name: Focusable
implementation_rule: Use to preserve visible keyboard focus when composing a custom interactive element.

name: Progress indicator
implementation_rule: Show position through a short ordered flow; do not treat an arbitrary count as completed progress.

name: Progress tracker
implementation_rule: Use for sequential workflow steps with actual completion state and recovery to unfinished steps.

name: Code
implementation_rule: Use CodeBlock for examples and identifiers. Never include live secrets in screenshots, examples or documentation.

name: Dynamic table
implementation_rule: Use the shared Table wrapper with sortable values, cursor pagination, loading/error/empty states and local overflow.

name: Heading
implementation_rule: One h1 per page, then ordered section headings. Visual size does not determine semantic heading level.

name: Inline edit
implementation_rule: Provide explicit edit, save and cancel states with validation; preserve the last confirmed value if saving fails.

name: Table
implementation_rule: Avoid adding the caution-marked low-level table package. Continue using DynamicTable for ordinary resource lists.

name: Table tree
implementation_rule: Use only for genuine hierarchical records with meaningful expand/collapse and keyboard behavior.

name: Visually hidden
implementation_rule: Use for context that must remain accessible while hidden visually; never hide focusable actions accidentally.

name: CSS
implementation_rule: Evaluate the supported beta package before migrating styling; do not bypass semantic design tokens.

name: CSS reset
implementation_rule: Import once at the application entry point, before app styles. Audit global element overrides after changes.

name: Design tokens
implementation_rule: Use semantic token names, not resolved values. Verify the token exists in the pinned package and every supported theme.

name: Entry Points
implementation_rule: Review release status and supported entry paths; do not import internal dist files in production code.

name: Motion
implementation_rule: Use purpose-driven transitions with reduced-motion support and a static way to understand state.

name: Popper
implementation_rule: Prefer a standard dropdown or popup. Use low-level positioning only for an unmet interaction requirement.

name: Portal
implementation_rule: Do not add new direct use of deprecated portal APIs. Let supported overlay components manage layers.

name: Pragmatic drag and drop
implementation_rule: Add only for an actual reorder task with persistence and a keyboard alternative.

name: App provider
implementation_rule: Keep one app provider and RouterLink integration. Theme initialization must remain centralized.

name: ESLint plugin
implementation_rule: Plan the official lint plugin with compatible pinned versions; documenting it does not mean it is installed.

name: Storybook addon
implementation_rule: Use when Storybook is introduced to review theme variants; do not claim Storybook exists today.

name: Stylelint plugin
implementation_rule: Use a version-compatible stylelint setup to catch raw and obsolete tokens when introduced.

name: UI Styling Standard
implementation_rule: Check current release status and compatibility before adoption; do not add deprecated tooling.

name: Atlassian navigation
implementation_rule: Do not introduce; migrate toward the current navigation-system approach.

name: Layout grid
implementation_rule: Use for two-dimensional responsive content; minmax(0, 1fr) prevents long text from forcing page overflow.

name: Onboarding (spotlight)
implementation_rule: Do not introduce the deprecated onboarding package; use current task-focused guidance.

name: Page layout
implementation_rule: Do not introduce; retain the semantic shared shell until a supported navigation migration is reviewed.

name: Side navigation
implementation_rule: Do not introduce; the dashboard no longer imports this deprecated navigation component.

name: Tokens
implementation_rule: Use semantic token names, not resolved values. Verify the token exists in the pinned package and every supported theme.

name: Accessibility
implementation_rule: Keep all task flows keyboard-operable, visible focus, semantic landmarks and text labels. Test themes, narrow screens, zoom and errors.

name: Content
implementation_rule: Use concise action-first labels, sentence case and specific recovery text. Separate measured delivery outcomes from assumptions.

name: Spacing
implementation_rule: Use the ADS spacing scale through tokens. Group related controls with small gaps and separate sections with larger gaps.

name: Grid
implementation_rule: Use consistent responsive columns and readable content widths; allow tables to scroll locally.

name: Color
implementation_rule: Choose foreground and background by semantic role and theme. Never rely on color alone for status.

name: Typography
implementation_rule: Use Heading, Text and MetricText for their respective roles. Preserve rem scaling and one h1 per page.

name: Motion
implementation_rule: Use purpose-driven transitions with reduced-motion support and a static way to understand state.

name: Iconography
implementation_rule: Use installed ADS core icons. Hide decorative icons and label icon-only actions.

name: Illustrations
implementation_rule: Use only when it helps explain an empty or onboarding state; keep decoration secondary to the task.

name: Logos
implementation_rule: Retain mymorphix identity. Do not use an Atlassian logo to imply product ownership or certification.

name: Elevation
implementation_rule: Match surface background and shadow to the actual layer; use overlay elevation only for temporary layers.

name: Border
implementation_rule: Use border width and semantic border tokens for boundaries, selected states and keyboard focus.

name: Radius
implementation_rule: Use the installed radius token for each surface and control; do not invent unrelated corner sizes.

name: Design
implementation_rule: Follow setup and composition guidance against the pinned React and Atlaskit versions; preserve the existing project architecture.
